matching_policy.normalize: Unicode NFKC, collapse whitespace, normalize apostrophes and hyphens for lookup, but preserve presentation/official tickers; case-fold ordinary phrases only.
matching_policy.match: Use longest whole-token/phrase match. Never match substrings (e.g. US inside USD, Fed inside FedEx).
matching_policy.priority: Named verified companies or financial pairs > named people and institutions > specific instrument > named event > macro data > sector > geography > status. On equal span, use priority number then context confidence.
matching_policy.short_alias: Short uppercase aliases such as US, MAS, SNB, Xi, C, SE, MY, AI and ticker symbols need context checks; do not treat common pronouns/verbs/syllables as tags.
matching_policy.multi_label: A story may carry independent tags across multiple axes, but a keyword span receives only one dominant text colour. Keep editorial status as a separate chip.
matching_policy.source: Tags can be assigned from verified headline metadata, but claims in explanations require verified article evidence. Unverified tickers/people must not be inferred.
matching_policy.direction: FX pairs are ordered base/quote; never flip USD/SGD and SGD/USD.
matching_policy.semantics: Urgency/direction (breaking, risk, gains, losses) must not be inferred from entity name or hue. Red used for China or Russia is a category identifier, not a market sell signal.
matching_policy.accessibility: Use text_light on light backgrounds and text_dark on dark backgrounds, with respective chip backgrounds; preserve written labels/icons and do not communicate meaning solely by colour.
matching_policy.hierarchy: Story has primary_category and independent arrays of region, political figures, institution, asset, sector, company/ticker, macro_data, event and editorial status tags.

rule_definitions.geo: Named place or demonym; exact word/phrase. Short abbreviations uppercase; disambiguate US pronoun, SG ticker, HK stock exchange by context.
rule_definitions.person: Full name exact; surnames/titles only with confirmed political/person context. Never tag surname embedded in company names or unrelated uses.
rule_definitions.institution: Official name or known acronym with institutional/market context; do not match ordinary verbs or parts of longer words.
rule_definitions.asset: Instrument phrase with finance context. Prevent broader instrument tag from overriding a more specific instrument.
rule_definitions.ticker: Exact $TICKER or exchange-qualified ticker, otherwise case-sensitive ticker plus resolved company context; company names use whole phrase. No substring matching.
rule_definitions.sector: Named industry/theme as whole phrase; require sector/market context for short ambiguous terms.
rule_definitions.macro: Statistic name or exact acronym with macroeconomic context; distinguish data release from an event.
rule_definitions.event: Exact named event or event phrase with evidence; do not infer an event from generic sentiment.
rule_definitions.status: Use only for verified editorial state (new, follow-up, correction, catch-up, breaking, partial); never infer from headline words alone.
rule_definitions.fxpair: Explicit currency pair or normalized slash/hyphen form with quote/base direction intact; never split inside a currency pair.
